description: Card-position rules for generated Kotoba units. These rules describe when material may first appear; they do not require every card to be rigidly templated.

cardBands.purpose: Introduce current-unit vocabulary immediately inside short familiar sentence frames, using known review or lexicon words as same-card scaffolding.
Drill current-unit vocabulary in modular sentence frames.
Introduce and drill the unit grammar focus after the word set has been warmed up.
Mix current vocabulary, due SRS vocabulary, helper words, and previously introduced grammar. No first exposures.

generationPriorities: current-unit material appears immediately; review-due or lexicon vocabulary scaffolds the same card when useful
current-unit vocabulary is introduced one learner-facing element at a time inside sentence context
current-unit vocabulary is drilled before new grammar carries the lesson
new grammar appears before the review-and-mix band
review-due vocabulary returns naturally once current material is in motion
late cards should combine known material rather than introduce new learner-facing material
